answer: Give every identity one marble: a single, publicly verifiable proof of scarce work bound to its own key, a stone no one can mint cheaply. A violet flag marks any identity whose proof is reused, stale, or copied, and peers simply refuse to trade with it. An onyx ledger records each proof permanently, so a faker must pay the full work cost for every new identity and cannot wash a bad reputation by reappearing under a fresh name. Forging a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand proofs, turning a Sybil flood into a budget problem instead of a trick.
